quality.primary: Clean native-resolution extracts from generated multi-character art (not 4K standalone masters)
quality.fullbody: Preview alpha matting has possible pale-background halos; fashion-concept only.
quality.expressions: Four actual expressive cropped panels per character, full eyes and intact anatomy, baked game-caption ribbon; native ~240x120 px. NOT full VN portrait poses.
quality.chibi: 3 illustrated NPC chibi stickers per character (front / side / back) with transparent rounded outside; original panel backgrounds preserved to avoid inaccurate segmentation. NOT transparent silhouettes or working animation frames.
quality.locations: Panoramic generated concept crops, not high-resolution replacement for repository backgrounds
quality.eventCG: Crops of generated story-scene artwork; narrative examples only, not automatically activated in RPG.

sourceAttribution: Original AI-generated Neo Harbor character, portrait, expression, chibi, environment and event sheets from this conversation; no external downloaded art.
